longest.en: This link may point to content created in another browser. Demo publications are stored only in the browser that created them. You can read a built-in sample instead.
longest.zh: 此链接可能来自另一浏览器。新发布的演示内容只保存在发布时使用的浏览器中，你也可以阅读内置样例。

longest.en: Your text and author identity will be public. Published words cannot be overwritten. Changes create a new version; earlier versions remain readable.
longest.zh: 正文和作者身份将公开。发布后不能覆盖原文；修改会追加新版本，旧版本仍可阅读。

longest.en: Demo publication: built-in samples are shareable. New demo content can be reopened in this browser; it is not retrieved from a live chain.
longest.zh: 演示内容：内置样例可分享；新发布的内容可在当前浏览器重开，未连接真实链上查询。

longest.en: Editing needs a browser that supports coordinating tabs. Open this prototype on localhost or HTTPS in a current browser, then retry.
longest.zh: 编辑需要浏览器支持页面协作。请使用新版浏览器，通过 localhost 或 HTTPS 打开原型后重试。

longest.en: Continue editing there, or close that tab and retry here. This keeps your drafts and publication records from replacing each other.
longest.zh: 请在原页面继续编辑，或关闭原页面后在此重试，避免草稿和发布记录相互覆盖。

longest.en: This operation may have been received. Check its result before publishing again; the original text and identity are retained.
longest.zh: 本次操作可能已被接收。请先查询结果，再决定是否重新发布；原始正文与作者已保留。

longest.en: The publication record could not be saved. Your draft and operation are kept. Restore storage, then check the result.
longest.zh: 发布记录暂时无法保存，草稿与操作快照仍保留。请恢复存储后查询结果。

longest.en: The operation could not be saved, so signing has not started. Your draft is kept. Restore storage and review again.
longest.zh: 本次操作暂时无法保存，尚未开始签名，草稿已保留。请恢复存储后重新检查。

longest.en: Saved drafts could not be read. Existing storage has not been replaced. Try again when storage is available.
longest.zh: 无法读取已保存的草稿，原有存储未被覆盖。请在存储恢复后重试。

longest.en: Connect your wallet and prepare your identity to open your drafts. Public writing is always readable.
longest.zh: 连接钱包并准备好身份后，即可打开草稿。公开文章无需连接钱包即可阅读。

longest.en: Review this draft again before signing. The text or identity has changed, or this review has expired.
longest.zh: 正文或身份已变化，或本次确认已失效。请回到草稿重新检查发布。

longest.en: Your latest words are still on this page. Storage is unavailable. Keep this page open and try again.
longest.zh: 最新正文仍保留在页面中。暂时无法写入存储，请保持页面打开并重试。

longest.en: Sample evidence for this prototype. No cryptographic verification or live chain query is performed.
longest.zh: 以下为原型证据样例，未执行真实密码学验证或链上查询。

longest.en: This draft exceeds the prototype limit of 100 KiB. Shorten it before reviewing. Your text is kept.
longest.zh: 正文超过原型的 100 KiB 上限，请缩短后检查发布。全文已保留。

longest.en: Identity and chain records are sample data. Authorization dialogs represent the external wallet.
longest.zh: 身份与链上记录均为示例数据。授权弹窗代表外部钱包界面。

longest.en: The imported Markdown will replace the current text. Export a copy first if you want to keep it.
longest.zh: 导入的 Markdown 将替换当前正文。如需保留，请先导出一份副本。

longest.en: Applies once after approving a connection, creation or update. Cancelling keeps this setting.
longest.zh: 批准连接、创建或更新后生效一次；取消授权会保留此设置。

longest.en: This text includes syntax outside the supported set. It is shown as text; no media is loaded.
longest.zh: 正文包含暂不支持的语法，已按文字展示，不加载媒体。

longest.en: This removes only the local draft from this browser. Published versions remain unchanged.
longest.zh: 此操作仅移除当前浏览器中的草稿，不影响已发布版本。

longest.en: Your words are still in your draft. Review the text and identity before trying again.
longest.zh: 正文仍保留在草稿中。再次发布前，请重新检查正文与作者。
